title: Projection Space Implementation of Deep Learning-Guided Low-Dose Brain PET Imaging Improves Performance over Implementation in Image Space

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Projection Space Implementation of Deep Learning-Guided Low-Dose Brain PET Imaging Improves Performance over Implementation in Image Space》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】Our purpose was to assess the performance of full-dose (FD) PET image synthesis in both image and sinogram space from low-dose (LD) PET images and sinograms without sacrificing diagnostic quality using deep learning techniques.

evidence.text: Our purpose was to assess the performance of full-dose (FD) PET image synthesis in both image and sinogram space from low-dose (LD) PET images and sinograms without sacrificing diagnostic quality using deep learning techniques.

sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:

【Abstract · abstract-1-2】Methods: Clinical brain PET/CT studies of 140 patients were retrospectively used for LD-to-FD PET conversion.
